question: Will Bruno Fernandes win the 2026 PFA Player of the Year?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2025-26 PFA Players' Player of the Year.

If two or more players are announced as winners of the 2026 PFA Players’ Player of the Year award, this market will resolve to the player whose listed last name comes first alphabetically.

If no 2025-2026 PFA Players' Player of the Year winner is declared by August 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official information from the Professional Footballers’ Association; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

evidence.publisher: Press Association, published by Express & Star
evidence.excerpt: Rice was a key performer in Arsenal’s Premier League title success and their run to the Champions League final, where they lost on penalties to Paris St Germain. Raya won the Premier League’s Golden Glove, while Gabriel was a solid presence at the back and a threat at attacking set-pieces. Haaland scored a league-high 27 goals, while Cherki was a revelation after joining Manchester City the previous summer. Fernandes contributed 21 assists as Manchester United secured a return to the Champions League.

The Coca-Cola Premier League Golden Playmaker prize has been won by Bruno Fernandes after he produced the most assists in 2025/26. The Portuguese created 21 goals across the campaign, a Premier League record, surpassing Thierry Henry and Kevin De Bruyne. He set the record by creating a goal in United’s final fixture away to Brighton & Hove Albion.
Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes has been named Premier League player of the season.

Bruno Fernandes has been crowned Footballer of the Year in the Football Writers’ Association annual awards. He beat runner-up Declan Rice by 28 votes, with Manchester City’s Haaland third. Fernandes took 45 per cent of votes from the FWA’s membership of more than 900. He was the only United player nominated, while Arsenal votes were divided between Rice, David Raya, Gabriel Magalhães and Bukayo Saka.

Paul Merson argued that Declan Rice should have won the Football Writers’ Association award after his role in Arsenal’s Premier League title campaign and run to the Champions League final. He said United’s lack of European football should be taken into account when assessing Fernandes. Merson also suggested that several strong Arsenal performers had divided support, whereas Fernandes stood out at United.

Liverpool’s Mohamed Salah has been voted the 2024-25 Men’s PFA Players’ Player of the Year. Salah topped the polling of his fellow professionals from the six-man shortlist. He had also received the 2024-25 Football Writers’ Association Footballer of the Year and Premier League Player of the Season awards.
